purpose: Make cross-module play failures visible before a package is called phone-ready or co-op-ready.
hard_gate: inspectable controller evidence exists inside the game package
phone claims include touch and responsive viewport evidence
phone claims include a LAN delivery route
runtime-issued controller links declare their metadata endpoint
dedicated controller delivery declares its runtime path
authoritative game state remains server owned
host reload has an explicit resume route
a shared screen never consumes a player seat
an external collaborator seat declares a structured seat-visible observation interface
an external collaborator uses the same authoritative action gate as a human seat
never_hidden: escape from blocking overlays or menus
origin_lessons: previewing controls is not consent to ready
QR handoff must preserve the exact seat and runtime token
refresh must reattach instead of resetting the host shell
a disconnected menu owner must not trap connected players
visual overlays need an explicit escape path
external collaborator is a Hub-connected seat, never a relabelled built-in bot
no rendered screen still requires a complete decision-relevant structured view
seat-visible state excludes private or omniscient world truth
an unattended child runtime must not consume the body forever
